objectives.en: Name the five dimensions of business environment

narration.en: When the RBI raises interest rates, car showrooms feel it within weeks. When UPI arrives, every kirana shop changes. Each change comes through one of five dimensions of the environment.
narration.kn: ಆರ್‌ಬಿಐ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರ ಏರಿಸಿದರೆ ಕಾರು ಮಾರಾಟ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಯುಪಿಐ ಬಂದಾಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಬದಲಾಯಿತು. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಪರಿಸರದ ಐದು ಆಯಾಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದರ ಮೂಲಕ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The economic environment includes interest rates, inflation, incomes and the stock market. The social environment includes customs, values, lifestyle and demographic trends. The technological environment covers new methods and products. The political environment covers political stability and government attitude to business. The legal environment includes laws, court judgements and regulations.

narration.en: The economic environment includes interest rates, inflation, incomes and the stock market. The social environment includes customs, values, lifestyle and demographic trends. narration.kn: ಆರ್ಥಿಕ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ, ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾನೂನು ಪರಿಸರಗಳು ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಪರಿಸರದ ಐದು ಆಯಾಮಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: dimensions with examples

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Let us make a two-column table: the dimension and an Indian example.
Economic: RBI changes the repo rate, so loan EMIs change.
Social: health awareness raises demand for millets and gyms.
Technological: UPI and e-commerce change how we sell.
Political: a stable government builds investor confidence.
Legal: laws like the Consumer Protection Act and labelling rules.

explanation.en: Economic, social, technological, political and legal forces together make up the general environment of business.

body.en: Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Legal: say "PESTL" and you have all five dimensions.

caption.en: Economic environment: how the interest rate changes a loan EMI

narration.en: Move the interest rate, the loan amount and the period. See how a small rise in the rate raises the monthly EMI, which can reduce demand for cars and homes.

tryThis.en: Keep ₹5 lakh for 5 years. Raise the rate from 9% to 10%: how much does the EMI rise?
Why would car dealers worry when RBI raises the repo rate?
Increase the period: what happens to the EMI and to the total interest?

problem.en: Classify each change into a dimension of business environment: (a) RBI raises the repo rate; (b) more people prefer online shopping; (c) a new e-waste law; (d) faster 5G networks.

steps.en: (a) Repo rate affects interest and loans: economic.
(b) A change in buying habits: social.

answer.en: Economic, social, legal and technological respectively.

narration.kn: ರೋಲ್ ಕಾಲ್ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಾಜರಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿ.

narration.en: Now some CBSE board pattern questions: assertion–reason and case based.

points.en: Five dimensions: economic, social, technological, political, legal.
points.kn: ಐದು ಆಯಾಮಗಳು: ಆರ್ಥಿಕ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ, ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ, ಕಾನೂನು.

points.en: Economic changes like interest rates affect costs and demand.
points.kn: ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರದಂತಹ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Social and technological changes alter what customers want.
points.kn: ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Political and legal factors set the rules of business.
points.kn: ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾನೂನು ಅಂಶಗಳು ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ನಿಯಮ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

homework.en: Give two Indian examples for each dimension of business environment.

narration.en: Recap. Five dimensions: economic, social, technological, political, legal. Economic changes like interest rates affect costs and demand. Social and technological changes alter what customers want. Political and legal factors set the rules of business.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಐದು ಆಯಾಮಗಳು: ಆರ್ಥಿಕ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ, ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ, ಕಾನೂನು. ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರದಂತಹ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ತಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾನೂನು ಅಂಶಗಳು ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ನಿಯಮ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
